name: Lord Arkkoroc
summary: Along Azshara’s ragged coast, Lord Arkkoroc commands the waters around his ruined temple. Loramus Thalipedes calls him a lesser deity, and the sea giants he calls his sons patrol the shore.

sections.title: Lord of the Sunken Coast
sections.body: Lord Arkkoroc holds the ruined Temple of Arkkoran above Azshara’s coast. Loramus Thalipedes, a hermit, regards the colossal sea giant as a lesser deity. His will shapes the waters around the temple. His sons patrol the crags and shallows, keeping his dominion over the shore.

sections.title: Vengeance Against the Deep
sections.body: Lord Arkkoroc has lost many sons beneath the tides. The many-headed hydra Hetaera hunted them along the cliffs and butchered them. For a traveler strong enough to bring him the beast’s heads, Arkkoroc offers valuable knowledge and occult aid.

faq.answer: Lord Arkkoroc is a massive sea giant who dwells in the Temple of Arkkoran in Azshara. Loramus Thalipedes regards him as a lesser deity of the seas. Arkkoroc rules the sea giants he calls his sons.

faq.q: Where can I find Lord Arkkoroc?
faq.answer: You can find Lord Arkkoroc among the ruins of the Temple of Arkkoran, on Azshara’s eastern coastline and rocky reefs.

faq.q: Why does Loramus Thalipedes send adventurers to Arkkoroc?
faq.answer: Loramus Thalipedes sends travelers to Arkkoroc for arcane insight about a powerful demon. Arkkoroc holds ancient knowledge, but demands that travelers slay the hydra Hetaera before he shares his secrets.

faq.q: Why is Arkkoroc angry with the hydra Hetaera?
faq.answer: Hetaera slaughtered several of Arkkoroc’s sons as they patrolled the coastline. Arkkoroc seeks revenge for his slain kin and demands the hydra’s heads.

angles.text: The Temple of Arkkoran stands on former Highborne lands. An ancient sea entity now rules over the fallen majesty of old Kalimdor.
